display_long_description:
Monko VR throws you into a high-energy virtual world where movement is everything. Using a fully hand-driven locomotion system inspired by Gorilla Tag, you’ll push, swing, climb, and launch yourself across vibrant maps with complete freedom and control. There are no buttons to move—just your skill, timing, and creativity.

Explore a variety of environments designed for speed, flow, and vertical gameplay. Whether you're scaling massive structures, escaping other players, or pulling off advanced movement techniques, every moment feels active and rewarding. The more you play, the more you improve, unlocking new ways to move faster and outplay others.

Monko VR focuses on competitive and social fun, letting you hang out with friends, challenge players, and create unforgettable moments through pure movement. Easy to pick up but difficult to truly master, it’s all about momentum, precision, and pushing your limits.
